scope: Additive independent manual source review plus file hashes; no helper/container/project execution
finding: The phase source verifier previously trusted the container manifest list without binding its bytes to the frozen host package manifest hash
resolution: Every non-Stage phase passes frozen package.manifest_sha256 as the third verifier argument; verifier hashes raw container CAPSULE_MANIFEST.json bytes and refuses mismatch before parsing or checking members. Existing host manifest/self/extractor binding, ZIP/card guards and all phase CLIs remain intact.
